expected_value_creation: QIF can expose denominator loss and bound how unavailable outcomes could reverse a verdict without claiming why data is missing.
beneficiary: QIF evaluators, governance owners, and affected stakeholders
supporting_evidence: NIST AI 800-4 identifies missing high-quality ground truth and longitudinal tracking as monitoring barriers.
OpenAI monitorability evaluations withhold unreliable datapoints instead of reporting them as ordinary results.
success_criteria: Verifier reproduces disposition counts and rejects denominator mismatches.
Best-case and worst-case outcome bounds and conclusion sensitivity are reproducible.
Insufficient or conclusion-changing missingness routes governance.
